FAQ.title: Frequently Asked
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know before your adventure.

items.q: Do I need a driver's license?
items.a: No, you don't need a driver's license. Our quads and buggies are automatic and very easy to drive. Our professional guides will give you full safety instructions and training before we start.
We recommend wearing comfortable clothing that you don't mind getting dusty. Closed shoes (sneakers) are mandatory for safety. Sunglasses are highly recommended. We provide helmets and safety gear.
Yes! Children are very welcome as passengers with an adult. For safety reasons, they must be at least 6 years old to ride as a passenger, and cannot drive the vehicles themselves.

items.q: Is hotel pickup and drop-off included?
items.a: Yes, absolutely. We provide free pick-up and drop-off from all hotels and residences located in the Agadir touristic zone.

items.q: Can I bring my camera or phone?
items.a: Yes, you can bring your phone or small camera to take pictures during the stops. However, for your safety, you cannot hold a phone while driving. Our guides will also take professional photos for you!
